# QR Code generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, tag `js2.0.4`, commit `83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8/js/dist/qrcode.js

SHA-256: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`.

The full MIT licence is in `qrcode-LICENSE`. `build.mjs` includes both the licence and encoder in the two teacher pages. QR codes are generated locally from the public student link. No QR URL or pupil data is sent to a QR service.
